propositions: ADF is hardwired into Cloud REST v3 path while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup, creating duplicate rich-text handling logic in map_fields_to_remote across backends

A four-operation Protocol (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must model rich-text encoding to preserve existing Cloud behavior where fit and normalize are separately composed by different callers
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/ (not jira_family/) to satisfy J2's import-contract requirement that jira_family imports nothing from location-pinned adapters/jira

Exactly one real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py, taking RichTextCodec as a constructor dependency, with Cloud/DC differences parameterized by codec selection
WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767 characters) with truncation marker matching adf._ADF_TRUNCATION_SUFFIX wording, and marker is counted against limit
